scenarios: Fetch activation requires tap, pay 1 life and sacrifice source as costs before ability enters stack
Three opponent seats can pass or scripted response before fetch ability resolves; target selected only on resolution
Fetch searches actual library for basic types including typed duals/trilands and optionally pays 2 life on shock ETB; shuffles remaining cards after moving target to battlefield
Fetch has no mandatory target and may fail to find; no unsupported utility land can be selected as a fake mana target
Fetch does not use a land drop for the searched target and keeps every physical ID exactly once
Ancient Tomb taps for two colorless immediately and deals two damage to its controller as part of mana ability resolution; no opponent-loss contribution
City of Brass taps for any U/B/R mana with a distinct damage trigger on stack, whose resolution requires four successive player passes, and source removal does not erase trigger
Casting a spell using City creates the City trigger after the physical cast; mana payment and card/zone changes are atomic; stack ordering is auditable
The source-backed planner can use one Ancient Tomb for a two-generic Arcane Signet and can account for City mana pending damage
Every new land checks exact frozen Oracle text/type against October Scryfall; no unregistered land guessed

sample_policy.opening: Exactly identical 7-card opening for every paired seed; subsequent draws may diverge after real fetch shuffle
sample_policy.land_choice: First supported land held in hand; include fetches and two utility lands; play one per own turn
sample_policy.fetch_choice: Activate on own main phase if modeled legal and controller life > 1; choose from actual library using deterministic first untapped, greatest modeled color flexibility, alphabetic ordering; never fabricate hidden card
sample_policy.shock_choice: For a fetched shockland, pay 2 life only if pilot life > 2, then land enters untapped; else tapped
sample_policy.mana_policy: Physically tap modeled lands; minimize controller damage, then source count, then stable card IDs; never silently spend unsupported mana
sample_policy.card_action: Only actually held Arcane Signet is attempted; no other full deck spells/actions evaluated
sample_policy.opponents: Three assumed opponents pass priority unless tests explicitly inject external scripted outcomes
sample_policy.life_game_end: Block potentially lethal controller damage to avoid claiming full state-based-action support

oracle_gate: Locked October Scryfall must independently validate card name, land type, ability cost/timing, selector subtypes and utility land source/damage text; frozen checksums apply.
limits: No full Magic multiplayer priority or response spelling, prevention/replacement, life-ending actions, fetchland search choice optimization, opponent AI, win rates or mulligans
Only ten named fetchlands, City of Brass, Ancient Tomb and Cycle103 modeled basic/nonbasic lands; unsupported fetch target types omitted from limited source availability and explicitly reported
A fetch's library shuffle causes later draw order to differ from Cycle103, so matching all 4 post-shuffle draws is expressly prohibited
City damage triggering and Ancient Tomb mana ability have different timing; no generic self-life penalty proxy
This is engineering coverage only, not any of the 62 independent Commander-first refinement certificates, formal Phase B or Pass C/I/J
